ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 30 percent high-intensity white pixels localized on the outer lobes against a 70 percent low-intensity dark grey/black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches on the distal halves of both lobes; dense constellation of dark circular spots mapped across white regions; solid low-intensity black central region from notch to peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with sharp peaks and irregular valleys; amplitude of serrations is greater on the distal regions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe margins exhibit a strong convex upward trajectory, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark-pixel clusters distributed across the high-intensity white regions; white-pixel clusters on the far-left and far-right distal tips indicating barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Group of four vertical, parallel dark-pixel rake marks located on the upper-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes; distinct linear rake marks on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy mottling pattern on the left lobe with high-density focal dark spots.
